title: Roller: 3D dice (three.js + cannon) that act out the engine's roll
description: Port the prototype's 3D dice (dice-roller.html, Dice3D) into apps/web as presentation only. ttg.dice picks every face (secure RNG, exact odds); the 3D layer throws each die and lands it on the chosen face (e.g. simulate the throw, read the face it would land on, then rotate the die's face mapping so that face shows the chosen symbols, or steer the final settle). Requirements: shown face always equals the engine face (test it); no cocked/ambiguous rests in the final frame; 2D SVG tumble when prefers-reduced-motion or no WebGL; load three.js + cannon on first roll only; result, odds, spends and log unchanged. See docs/plan.md (Client-side dice).
notes: Built and deployed to dev 2026-10-24 (https://d1rou3s0igp8o4.cloudfront.net/roller/index.html). Live Playwright check: 3D faces match result card on phone and desktop, ~3.3-4s from Roll to result, canvas fades, reduced motion skips 3D, no console errors. Waiting on user review to close. Follow-up: shrink dice3d.js chunk (filed).
